method: RAM-only whole-glyph domestic crosscheck. All 30 primary and 8 alternate paths reviewed; 8 normalized cumulative states and all three final forms inspected. Not exam-body certification.

notes: Primary 1–8 matches domestic order and directions: dot, horizontal/down-left bend, vertical, right dot, right vertical, short horizontal, left vertical, bottom horizontal.

All 8 normalized cumulative states and final form reviewed at width 5. Left component 2/3/4 remains connected, right verticals 5/7 meet bottom 8, right horizontal 6 attaches to 5, and components stay separated.
HzFst alternative also reviewed in all 8 paths using domestic mapping [1,2,3,4,6,5,7,8]; no advantage over the original-order primary candidate.
Uniform 100/109 normalization; unchanged original order and curves. Catalog 9 preserved as dictionary playback variant 8.
All 12 full paths and directions compared, then complete normalized form inspected.

Domestic final stroke 12 starts immediately below upper horizontal 6 and descends along the right side. Candidate 12 starts much lower near the central crossing, omitting that upper descending segment.
Candidate stroke 11 also reaches higher than the domestic short lower right falling stroke. Reordering and uniform scaling cannot reconcile the whole geometry.
No segment invented; catalog 13 remains unchanged.
entries.reopenWhen: Obtain licensed whole-glyph geometry matching the domestic upper start of final stroke 12, or independent domestic support for the full alternative form.

notes: All 10 paths and directions compared and final normalized form inspected.
Domestic stroke 9 is a horizontal followed by a straight downward vertical. Candidate 9 has repeated diagonal zigzag bends and a lower-left terminal.
Domestic final stroke 10 rises to the vertical foot before descending right; candidate 10 begins as a low continuous rightward sweep. The lower-left structure differs in the final form.
Matching 10-step playback count is insufficient; no split, merge or new coordinates applied.
entries.reopenWhen: Find licensed geometry with the domestic straight bent stroke 9 and matching final sweep, or independent domestic evidence supporting the candidate's entire variant.
